## Notes

Most opinion decays to 0; Tyranny decays 0.25 per month; diplomacy +1 per point; same dynasty +5; faith hostility 0 to -30; attraction such as Beautiful +30, Ugly -20; Friend +60, Best Friend +120, Rival -60, Nemesis -120; Broke Truce -50 for 3 years; predecessor opinion is the only inheritable opinion.
